latestPost.title: Ferrari's Monza ADUO Engine to Deliver 'At Least 15 HP', Reports AutoRacer
latestPost.quote: Ferrari's Monza-bound ADUO engine upgrade is worth at least 15 horsepower, Italian outlet AutoRacer reports - combining an upgraded combustion engine, a redesigned turbocharger and a new Shell fuel as the Scuderia maps a three-race plan from Zandvoort to Austin.
